title: Adding Learner Groups to Courses
intro: Course-side enrollment in Essentials 2.0: attach existing learner groups, review the resulting roster, handle exceptions, and make enrollment consequences clear within Semester → Courses. Screens and flows are evidence; unobserved synchronization behavior is identified as a gap.

questions.title: Group-as-unit enrolment (attach a group, membership stays synced) vs. copy-at-enrol
Preview of impact before confirming (member count, conflicts, already enrolled)
Roster view: status, role, group origin, exceptions visible
Bulk paths (CSV, code/link, integration) alongside manual add
Notifications to learners on enrolment (seam with 07/09 — note only)
